Full tier list

Your three Legacy picks are Uta [New Year], Rize [Valentine's Day] and Rize [Christmas] (see Meta teams); other units in the selector are options, not recommendations.

Rated from the game's own kit text and stats (EU datamine 2026-09-22). No community tier list covers the 2026 units: the reachable ones date from 2024–2025 and rank launch units that now have about half the stats of a 2026 limited unit.

At 0★ (the default) rates what a unit does with only its innate passive, which is where a free player keeps most units for weeks. At full stars rates the whole kit. Use that view for the weekly Abyssal Battlefield, which treats your unit as full stars. Your team and meta picks are on Meta teams.

"Listed for a shop around day N (unconfirmed)" means the data has a shop entry for that server day. Whether the shop sells the unit itself, and its cost, isn't in the data. "Back-up OK" = at least one passive is tagged to work from the back-up slot ("from 1★" = only a starred passive is).
